nodes.name: ScopePill.tsx
nodes.summary: ScopePill component: displays review scope badge (self, peer, manager, 360) with color coding, tooltip with description, and click handler for filter. Used in review list and management views.

nodes.name: history/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Performance review history page: timeline of past cycles, scores received/given, feedback summaries, trend chart (radar/spider), and export PDF. Uses PerformanceHistoryChart and ReviewCard components.

nodes.name: management/overview/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Management review overview: team completion rates, score distribution histogram, calibration flags, overdue reviews, and bulk actions (send reminder, extend deadline). Manager-only access via middleware.

nodes.name: management/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Performance management hub: tabs for overview, records, calibration, settings. Cycle configuration (dates, participants, weights), reviewer assignment matrix, and calibration session scheduler.

nodes.name: management/records/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Review records management: searchable table of all reviews in cycle, filter by status/score/reviewer, inline score editing, feedback moderation, and bulk export. Uses ReviewRecordTable and ScoreEditor components.

nodes.name: payroll/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Payroll page: monthly payroll runs, payslip generation, salary component breakdown, tax/deduction details, bank transfer status, and year-end reports. HR/Finance role required. Uses payrollService and PayslipViewer.

nodes.name: resignation/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Resignation workflow: submit request (notice period, reason, handover plan), approval chain visualization, exit interview scheduling, asset return checklist, final settlement calculator, and offboarding tracker.

nodes.name: settings/page.tsx
nodes.summary: User settings: profile (avatar, name, contact), notifications (email, push, in-app), security (password, 2FA, sessions), preferences (language, theme, timezone), and connected accounts. Uses settingsService.

nodes.name: documents/page.tsx
nodes.summary: Document management: file browser with folders, upload (drag-drop, progress), version history, sharing permissions, OCR search, preview modal (PDF, images, Office), and bulk actions. Integrates with MinIO via apiClient.
